_comment: OpenClaw as an MCP server, so agents can READ WhatsApp conversations.
Passed to the CLI with --mcp-config for agents that declare it, rather than
being registered globally in ~/.claude.json — a global entry would spawn an
OpenClaw bridge for every agent turn in every room, including the ones that
IMPORTANT: this server also exposes messages_send. Never grant
mcp__openclaw__* — grant the read tools by name, or an agent can post to any
of Dominic's groups directly, bypassing the per-room routing, the rate
limiter, and the rule that nobody but Dominic acts.
